name: Resilient Healthcare Corp
summary: Resilient Healthcare Corp, based in Las Vegas, Nevada, is a global company specializing in the production and distribution of various health, beauty, and food ingredients, as well as a wide selection of vitamins and dietary supplements. A unique aspect of their operations involves developing a proprietary method for converting liquid edible oils into a stable, free-flowing powdered form. These innovative "oil to powder" materials are then incorporated as components into a diverse array of finished consumer goods, such as human food, pet food, nutraceuticals, vitamin products, cosmetics, and eco-friendly household items. The company previously operated under the name Nutri Pharmaceuticals Research, Inc., adopting its current identity, Resilient Healthcare Corp, in November 2025.
